notes: Ruby T2 (`bgraph-eval t2 --ecosystem ruby`). Root directory defaults to $BGRAPH_EVAL_DIR/t2/ruby: checkouts <dir> (full clones, core.autocrlf=false, at R), one bundle per repo in <venv> (installed with BUNDLE_PATH=<root>/<venv>, BUNDLE_USER_HOME=<root>/bundlehome, BUNDLE_USER_CACHE=<root>/gemcache and the repo's env, `bundle install` in the checkout; on Windows set MAKE to MSYS2's usr/bin/make.exe so native gems such as bigdecimal build), oracle.jsonl. Ruby: $BGRAPH_EVAL_RUBY_BIN (directory of ruby.exe, prepended to PATH for the children) or ruby on PATH; measured with Ruby 3.4 (RubyInstaller UCRT). Suite = the runner's own file list: rspec -> RSpec.configuration.files_to_run for `spec` (the .rspec options apply); minitest/test-unit -> the file_list and libs of the Rake::TestTask `task`. Each test file runs in its own process (`ruby -rbundler/setup -e 'RSpec::Core::Runner.run(ARGV)' <args> FILE`, or `ruby -rbundler/setup -I<libs> <args> -e 'ARGV.each { |f| require File.expand_path(f) }' FILE`), 6 at a time; a file is red when its process exits non-zero or times out (failed example, load error of that file, crash). Unit = test file, as bgraph models it. `mutants` = killed mutants aimed at, `tries` = mutants generated at most. Mutants are one-token flips in lib/**/*.rb (==/!=, </>=, >/<=, &&/||, and/or, +/-, true/false, if/unless, integer +-1, simple string literal +"_mut", simple `return x` -> `return nil`). A mutant that fails `ruby -c` is dropped (nocompile) only when every test file goes red; otherwise it counts. Baseline = 2 runs of every file at R; red/differing files are excluded; each red file is re-run alone once to confirm.

repos.name: rack/rack
repos.covers: lib/rack (autoload-based: lib/rack.rb autoloads ~60 constants), test/spec_*.rb (Minitest spec style, named spec_*.rb: tests only through the Rakefile's TestTask test_files FileList) + test/gemloader.rb

repos.name: dry-rb/dry-types
repos.install: BUNDLE_WITHOUT=benchmarks:tools (the development group holds rspec through the gemspec); dry-struct comes from git
repos.covers: lib/dry/types (Zeitwerk loader, extensions loaded by Dry::Types.load_extensions), spec/ (35 *_spec.rb; .rspec --require spec_helper, which requires support/ and shared/ by Dir glob)

repos.name: ruby/rake
repos.install: all groups (test-unit is in the development group)
repos.covers: lib/rake (require-based), test/test_*.rb (test-unit; helper.rb + support/ via require_relative; some tests run exe/rake in a child Ruby). Capped at 80 evaluated mutants by decision of the phase lead (~80 s per mutant: test_rake_functional alone takes ~30 s); the first 80 mutants of the seeded order are the same for any tries >= 80.
